summary: Comprehensive testing of Football/Futsal Team Management App. All 10 requested features tested and PASSED. Backend (24 pytest tests 100% pass), Frontend (UI flows verified via Playwright screenshots). App successfully demonstrates JWT auth, team CRUD with age groups, compact team hub with sidebar navigation, squad management with availability toggles, statistics tab, AI training sessions, match events API, and multi-user data isolation.

minor.issue: HMAC key is 31 bytes (below recommended 32 bytes) - non-blocking warning

issues: Consider adding 'data-testid' to more sidebar menu items for easier automated testing

test_1_auth_flow.description: Register user (user1@test.com/pass123), login, JWT token verification via /api/auth/me endpoint

test_2_team_creation.description: Created football 11v11 team with age_group U16. Team appears in 'My Teams' list with correct format/age badges

test_3_team_hub_page.description: Compact layout with left sidebar (Squad, Tactics, Training, History, Match icons) and player table on right showing #, Name, Pos, Avl columns

test_4_add_players.description: Used + ADD button to add players. Players appear in table with number, name, position, availability dot

test_5_team_settings.description: Gear icon opens modal with FORMAT chips (5v5, 7v7, 9v9, 11v11) and AGE GROUP chips (U8-Senior). SAVE CHANGES button persists changes

test_6_squad_management.description: Squad view shows Availability tab with toggle switches for each player. Edit (pencil) and delete (X) buttons present

test_7_squad_statistics.description: U16 team (NOT under 13) shows Statistics tab with Min, Avg, G, A, Y, R columns. Stats would be hidden for U8-U12 teams

test_8_training_page.description: AI Training Sessions page loads with category buttons (General/Defensive/Attacking). Shows loading indicator 'Generating sessions with AI...' - API calls backend LLM endpoint

test_9_match_events_api.description: POST /api/matches/{match_id}/events accepts events with type (goal/yellow/red/sub), minute, player_id, detail fields. Events saved and retrievable

test_10_data_isolation.description: User 2 cannot see User 1's teams via API or UI. GET /api/teams returns only user's own teams. Direct access to other user's team ID returns 404

test_classes: TestAuthFlow (4 tests): register, login, token verification
